exceptions.reason: The authorized telemetry retention requires a narrow exception to the released append-only trigger and a bounded DELETE helper, which are outside the expand-safe allowlist. No cleanup executes in this migration. Invoker rights, FORCE RLS, exact current-tenant service context, the two telemetry types, the minimum age of 14 days, a maximum batch of 500 and undo-reference checks constrain every delete. The prune flag is assigned with set_config inside the function and restored before return, because a NOSUPERUSER migration role cannot store that placeholder in the function configuration. Other event and append-only table mutations remain rejected. The server runs cleanup after the release flow takes a fresh backup. This exact-byte artifact requires coordinator cross-family and release review; it grants no merge, push, deployment or release authority.
